newsitem.title: USA: Cross-Continent Auto sees margins declining.
newsitem.headline: Cross-Continent Auto sees margins declining.

text.p: Cross-Continent Auto Retailers Inc said Wednesday it expected its margins to decline amid fewer sales in the near future.
"Market conditions so far this quarter have weakened in the areas where we have operations," the automobile retail dealer said in a statement.

"Currently, we see no trends developing to reverse the softening of vehicle sales," it said. "As a result, we also expect margins per vehicle to decline in the near term." Cross-Continent, which owns and operates a group of franchised automobile retail dealerships in Texas, Oklahoma, Nevada and Colorado, said it was nevertheless optimistic for the long term.
It reported second-quarter net income of $1,866,000 on revenues of $135.4 million, versus a loss of $570,000 on revenues of $70.0 million.
